from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metrics from a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/Security code of the company")
    reporting_period_end: str | None = Field(description="End date of the reporting period, YYYY-MM-DD")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets at period end in CNY")
    equity_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Equity Attributable to Shareholders at period end in CNY")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders for the period in CNY")
    weighted_average_roe: float | None = Field(description="Weighted Average Return on Equity in percentage (e.g. 5.5 for 5.5%)")
    document_snippet: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the key figures for grounding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates financial data instances from all provided documents."""
    financial_reports: list[CompanyFinancialData]
